newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ifo-96 W German building investment to fall 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ifo-96 W German building investment to fall 20 pct.

text.p: Investment by west German construction firms is likely to fall around 20 percent in 1996 as the slump in the industry continues, the German economics institute Ifo said on Thursday.
Munich-based Ifo said it expected investment in plant and equipment in the sector to fall around a fifth to 5.1 billion marks this year, following the eight percent fall seen in 1995.
The forecast is gloomier than that published by the Ifo in July, when it forecast that investment by building firms would fall by some 15-16 percent in 1996.
But the institute said that the fall in production that the industry has experienced since 1995 should start to bottom out in 1997 after a further fall this year.

Ifo said total construction expenditure in the economy would fall a further four percent in 1996 but would level out in 1997. There were even signs of a small pick-up in activity in the commercial sector then, it added.

Despite the early optimistic signs, however, the Ifo said that only three percent of construction firms were expecting to increase their investment budgets next year, with 61 percent looking to make further cuts.
